subject: English
question_text: Complete the text with suitable prepositions.
stimulus: There are a great many kinds of animals and birds (a) ----- the wild. Some have died (b) ----- ever, some are in danger. The dodo is one of the birds which is now extinct. The early Portuguese explorers were the first to see the dodo. They were seeking a safe route (c) ----- India and discovered the island of Mauritius half-----way across the Indian Ocean in 1598. They used this island to have their ships restocked (d) ----- water and food. So whenever European trading ships stopped (e) ----- Mauritius, the sailors went ashore and hunted these birds for food.
guide_solution: Use of prepositions: (a) in; (b) for; (c) to; (d) with; (e) near.
